arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS quick_follow_on_transactions
FROM (
  SELECT date, lag(date) OVER (PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY date, id) AS previous
  FROM transactions
) AS g
WHERE previous IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(strftime('%s', date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', previous) AS INTEGER) < 120
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions whose gap to the previous transaction on the same card is under 120 seconds, so a gap of exactly 2 minutes is excluded.
assumptions: Gap measured in whole seconds between a transaction and the immediately preceding transaction on the same card; under 2 minutes means strictly less than 120 seconds.
Counts every transaction in the table, whether or not it has a fraud label, and regardless of amount sign or error status.
The first transaction on each card has no previous transaction and is not counted.
Transactions with identical timestamps on the same card are ordered by id to keep the result stable.
